readiness.hed: A Frost Advisory runs until 9 a.m. this morning, then a sunny, breezy Sunday near 65 with clear skies tonight near 41.
readiness.insight: The National Weather Service kept a Frost Advisory in effect through 9 a.m. this morning for Spotsylvania and surrounding counties after temperatures fell as low as 35 overnight. Sensitive outdoor plants left uncovered could be harmed or killed by the frost. Once the advisory lifts, Fredericksburg has a sunny day with a high near 65 and southwest wind 2 to 7 mph. Tonight is clear with a low around 41, and the sunny, breezy stretch continues into Monday and Tuesday with highs near 64 and 68.
actions: If sensitive plants were left uncovered overnight, check them this morning — the advisory runs until 9 a.m.
Today and Monday are good outdoor-work days: sunny, light wind, no rain in the seven-day forecast through Tuesday.
No other watches or warnings are posted for the Fredericksburg point this morning.
